visualCharacteristics: A light-grey section introducing the corporate group, with a heading and lead, overview boxes of illustrated items, a position figure with labelled items, notes and a business figure with lead text.
contentPattern: One row per part, classified by content: head [h2][lead p]; overview [h3, then per item h4, picture, h5, paragraphs]; position [h3, PC picture, SP picture, then per item h4, h5]; note [paragraphs with links]; business [h3, lead p, PC picture, SP picture, note p].
usage: Use it for the "about the group" section of a recruitment page with overview figures and business information.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it only for the same company-overview structure; use columns or cards for simpler about sections.
